subject: Linguistics
title: Word Associations
description: Learn Word Associations in one minute.

hook.text: Say 'salt' and most people instantly respond 'pepper.' The link is automatic.

buildup.text: Word association tests reveal how concepts are linked in the mental lexicon.

discovery.text: Adults tend to give syntagmatic responses (salt→pepper); children give paradigmatic ones (salt→sugar).

twist.text: This shift happens around age seven and reflects the growing organization of semantic networks.

climax.text: Association patterns are remarkably consistent across speakers of the same language.

punchline.text: Your word links reveal how your mind maps the world.

quiz.question: What response do adults typically give in word association?
